import_story.title: SO-V29-02 S6H Packet Office
import_story.description: v2.9 02 S6 harder corpus: three near-identical self-voiced members whose only systematic difference is their delivery sheet. The packet office in the invented town of Orraven sorts sealed deliveries at a shared counter beside the covered loading yard.

polish.notes: Blunt, everyday register. Use short statements and bare fragments. Put the main clause first. Skip ceremonial openings and rhetorical questions.
Formal register, without contractions. Build balanced complete sentences; link clauses with semicolons and explicit transitions. Never use slang or chummy asides.
Warm conversational register. Use contractions and linked clauses, with light question-tags or a brief self-rephrasing. Avoid formal signposting and telegraphic fragments.

qualities.rubric: Has the shift ended and everyone left the office?

checkpoints.name: Office
checkpoints.objective: At the checkpoint, the three equal-duty clerks must agree how to process the waiting deliveries and keep the dispatch list accurate.
